_comment: THE AGENT'S BRAIN. This file decides WHAT to make, WHERE to post it, and WHEN. Edit from the dashboard or by hand.
niche: your topic area here, for example: calm living, healthy habits, friendship

default.image_style: cinematic, warm, healing, soft light, aesthetically pleasing, polished, high detail
default.note: Appealing, confident female-led aesthetic that draws attention but stays platform-safe.

detect.self_healing_spiritual: calming, healing, warm light, serene, hopeful

google_trends.note: pulse check only (news/celebrity heavy - weak for faceless reels)

reddit.note: curiosity content + self-healing/spiritual/emotional niche that converts to faceless reels. DISABLED due to persistent 429 rate limiting - enable if you get API access.

youtube_trending.note: YouTube's classic /feed/trending page was discontinued by YouTube (confirmed 2026-09-02, redirects to home) - this now searches yt-dlp against topic-relevant terms spanning ALL our categories (facts/tech, business/finance, fitness, self-healing), not just one niche, so results stay trendy AND on-brand instead of generic pop-culture trending.

topics: how small daily habits change your mood
why a short walk helps you think
manual_list.note: Core niche: self-healing, spiritual, emotional connection. Ranked above scraped topics. Plus general curiosity.

trendpulse.note: Real-time trending FROM Mastodon and Bluesky - platforms we already post to, so this is on-brand signal not generic noise. Via the trend-pulse library (MIT, github.com/claude-world/trend-pulse), found + verified working 2026-09-02. Its own reddit source hits the same 403 block ours does, so left out here - google_trends already covered by our own source above.

feeds: Connecting people: how to make friends as an adult

telegram.note: No platform limit - 5 is reasonable for quality

tiktok.note: 3-5 posts safe. Avoid flagging for spam.

bluesky.note: No limit but 8/day keeps quality high

mastodon.note: No limit but 6/day is good mix

discord.note: No channel limit but 10/day is sensible

instagram.note: Platform cap is 25/day but 3 is safe.

linkedin.note: default, change it if you like

wordpress.note: default, change it if you like

webhook.note: default, change it if you like

rules._privacy_note: Uploads start PRIVATE so a bug can never publish garbage. Set connections.json youtube.privacy='public' once you trust it.
rules._blocked_note: Titles/descriptions containing these phrases are RECOMMENDED-FLAG / policy-sensitive. The agent strips them before posting so nothing gets flagged.

learning._note: A topic scoring 1.5x the average is a WINNER and gets more like it. Below 0.5x is a LOSER and gets avoided.

reliability._comment: Self-healing + catch-up. After any downtime (PC asleep, reboot, crash) the agent runs the posts it MISSED for today, spaced out, then resumes normal posting. It never floods.
reliability._catchup_gap_min: minimum minutes between two posts when clearing a backlog - stops a burst that trips spam filters
reliability._catchup_max_hours: a slot missed by more than this is written off for the day (a 9am post fired at 11pm helps nobody)
reliability._max_posts_per_day: hard ceiling on posts in one calendar day, catch-up included - final backstop

schedule_steady.note: YouTube Short #1 of the week - 06:00 Tuesday, auto-made + auto-posted to the presenter. (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
YouTube Short #2 of the week - 06:00 Friday, auto-made + auto-posted to the presenter. (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Monday image post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Wednesday text post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Thursday image post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Saturday text post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Sunday image post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)

dynamic_fillers._note: Real day-to-day randomization: different COUNT (5-8) and TIMES each day. At most 1 of them lands in the 8-11am low-traffic window. 35 min min gap enforced via catchup_gap_min.

dynamic_videos._note: No more fixed 8am slot - random 1-2 videos/day between noon and 9pm, when people are actually online. 35 min min gap enforced via catchup_gap_min.

dynamic_tiktok._note: TikTok's OWN track, separate from the shared YouTube video schedule above - always exactly 3/day, all between 12pm-5pm, hard-restricted to TikTok only (never also posts to YouTube/Telegram/etc). 35 min min gap enforced via catchup_gap_min.

dashboard_auth._note: Change this password before you do anything else. Turn it off only if the dashboard is never reachable from outside this computer.

ollama_failover.note: Sequential failover only. Never concurrent. The failed model is explicitly unloaded (keep_alive=0) before the next one is tried, so RAM never holds two large models at once - the exact failure that removed the old cascade on 2026-09-03.

schedule_generation.note: Local-only video post. SocialBlog (https://localhost:8543) is the ONLY destination - never live.

department.note: Social Media Department v3.1 (18 agents, 7 stages). enabled=false: the scheduler and dashboard buttons still use the old path; a deliberate manual department run works anyway (department_queue.py --enqueue ... --run). enabled=true hands scheduler and dashboard jobs to the department. allowed_platforms is the safety rail: the department publishes ONLY there (default: the local blog). live_publish=true lifts the rail - only the owner switches that. HELENA sends the Telegram report only when a job is enqueued with --notify.

retention._note: 3.0 (2026-10-11): ON. Published posts: their working files AND final files are deleted 7 days after publishing. NEVER deleted: anything not confirmed published, failed jobs awaiting retry, stock (waiting-for-publish) posts, the database, config, scripts. Logs older than 14 days are cleaned. Every deletion is logged first in data/retention.log. The SUPERVISOR's side desk triggers the sweep every sweep_hours.

_comment_old_scheduler: 2026-10-11: old scheduler generation switched OFF on purpose - the dispatcher (8 slots) + idle stock system own all posting now.
